difference_convention: three_free minus fixed_distance, paired within seed and n
interpretation: Scale 1 is well specified in both models. These data assess the extra-parameter variance cost, not scale-misspecification bias. Five paired seeds give descriptive comparisons, not a superiority or scaling-law claim.
regularization_disclosure: Three-free L2 penalizes all three physical weights, including scale; old L2 penalizes only turning and clearance. Positive-lambda sensitivities are not like-for-like.

identifiability_note: At doubled scale, covariance minimum eigenvalue 0.0302182 fails the recovery gate. The local scale standard deviation is larger than ratio standard deviations. Increasing determinism weakens scale information; human demonstrations may not identify scale well even when ratios appear stable.
